canada.title: Free patient-transport program extended in northern N.S.
canada.summary: A program helping northern Nova Scotians get to medical appointments will be extended after patients were blindsided to learn it would be ending next month. The free rides began as a pilot project in 2023, but were slated to end after funding dried up.

canada.summary: A young man from northwestern Alberta is accused of the online child sexual exploitation of an underaged girl in B.C., according to the Alberta Law Enforcement Response Teams (ALERT).

canada.title: Dartmouth school employee charged with child luring following investigation
